village.line: To hike over the island to the village
stanza: To hike over the island to the village
And enjoy the music and the food and the people
And see the great ships come and go
And, man, have me a ball

village.line: I always get lost when I leave the village
stanza: Body of water, toxic and timeless
I always get lost when I leave the village
So I couldn't come meet you in Brooklyn last night

village.line: And when I told the people in the village
village.linePrev: Like seeing the world and seeing through the world
village.lineNext: That I went out and never came back
